claims.rationale: JR Central museum release p.1 dates C1 prototype September 1997 and commercial service March 1999 and attributes Series 700 to both JR operators. JR Central 2015 guide pp.8–9 identifies 700 design basis of N700; independent Hitachi 2005 pp.163–165 describes prototype, tilted suspension, all-car semi-active control and regeneration. JSME award summary §1 and Figure 2 dates 2007 debut; JR history identifies Nozomi. https://jr-central.co.jp/news/release/_pdf/000020076.pdf ; https://www.au.emb-japan.go.jp/files/000163044.pdf ; https://www.hitachi.com/ICSFiles/afieldfile/2005/12/26/r2005_04_102.pdf ; https://www.jsme.or.jp/jsme/uploads/2016/11/awardn07-03.pdf

Ueno et al. abstract and introduction identify March 2006 new ATC on Tokaido; JR operator history corroborates. Hitachi 2005 pp.163–164 Fig.4 and JSME Fig.2 independently show location data feeding the tilt controller; requires is specifically limited to that implementation, not all tilt systems. Link direction is later system to underlying line and train to control. https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jsmestech/2009/0/2009__358170-1_/_article/-char/en ; https://www.hitachi.com/ICSFiles/afieldfile/2005/12/26/r2005_04_102.pdf

JR Central 2018 investor meeting p.10 dates test start; JR history July 2020 and Fuji/Nsk supply-chain accounts identify passenger start 1 July. Sato et al. §§2.3,3.1 and 6 trace blowerless cooling and prototype platform, while Fuji 2015 journal p.47, press release §2 and later case study independently document specific N700 variants and SiC N700 testing and N700S equipment. Scope is some N700 converters, with forced-air variant noted. https://global.jr-central.co.jp/en/company/ir/investor-meeting/2019/_pdf/im_2019_03.pdf ; https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/ieejjia/10/4/10_20012560/_pdf/-char/ja ; https://www.fujielectric.co.jp/about/company/gihou_2015/pdf/88-01/FEJ-88-01-0000-2015c.pdf ; https://www.fujielectric.co.jp/about/news/detail/20150625160012422.html

Kawasaki 30 January 2004 rollout describes Series 700 base and geographical and regulatory adaptations, corroborated by receiving Taiwan Railway Bureau specifications and route. Operator 2009 report Operational Highlights dates initial Banqiao–Zuoying passenger service 5 January 2007, separately corroborated by the Bureau’s station openings. Transmission points to model transferred; no inference that 700T led to N700ST engineering. https://global.kawasaki.com/en/corp/newsroom/news/detail/ba0401_01.html ; https://www.rb.gov.tw/zh-TW/main/main_28/20250505_152320/20251104_134001/20250505_180533/

THSRC 20 August 2025 named model and explicitly identifies N700S as reference and livery/interior/function localization. Hitachi Toshiba 30 July 2026 independently reports first 12-car shipment and intended operating environment. THSRC 16 November confirms first main-line test to 170 km/h Yanchao–Chiayi and explicitly forecasts, rather than reports, passenger operation July 2027. Procurement and operator statements support directed transmission. https://www.thsrc.com.tw/ArticleContent/e1e25e6a-4139-44d4-ac30-3f9724f08310 ; https://www.hitachi.com/en/press/articles/2026/07/0730a/ ; https://www.thsrc.com.tw/ArticleContent/69301a4b-e742-4695-b719-823f9f3342dc

JR Central history records Supreme Class Cabin starting 1 October 2026, with N700S equipment identified by its service release; THSRC September 2026 holiday announcement and April platform-door notice identify existing fleet and current 700T. Inventory is bounded to those dates; N700ST tested not in public service. JR S0 announcement 16 October 2026 is explicitly a proposal for 2029. Forward work remains questions rather than links. https://recommend.jr-central.co.jp/gooddayexpress/history/ ; https://www.thsrc.com.tw/ArticleContent/ecf8ea8d-8d26-4a69-98b4-46da667f7bac ; https://jr-central.co.jp/news/release/_pdf/000046070.pdf

corrections: Scoped the N700 blowerless equipment to some converters and added informative supplier corroboration of predecessor equipment and testing.
Corrected reporting-year versus publication-year for THSRC annual report.
Removed Taiwan MOTC yearbook because reviewer could not independently reach original; replaced with accessible Taiwan Railway Bureau original.
N700ST 16 November main-line run correctly designated demonstration, not revenue service.
deferred: Specific Series 300/300X technologies carried into Series 700; older infrastructure dependencies; post-cutoff N700ST testing and service authorization.
limitations: Evidence notes are paraphrases; original operator, supplier or engineering publications are the primary support. Inventory gives dated observations rather than continuous current-service guarantees.
